resources.string: Polaris can draft tasks or smaller steps from the text you select. It is optional, may be incorrect, and will not change anything until you review and confirm.
Polaris drafts are unavailable while you are offline. You can create the task manually instead.
Polaris drafts are an optional backup-account feature. You can continue planning without signing in.
Polaris drafts are off until you choose to use them. You can continue planning without AI.
Polaris drafts are not available right now. Your task stays on this device and you can continue manually.
This draft could not be verified. Nothing was changed.
The draft could not be confirmed. Nothing was changed.
This draft has expired. You can continue manually or request a new draft when you choose.
Choose at least one draft suggestion to review.
Your workspace stays on this device unless you choose backup and sync.
AI features are optional and only use selected content after your review.
Product analytics are optional and never include your task text.
